name: @natlang/pr-shepherd
description: Review pull-request hunks against team rules: crisp routine-hunk skipping, verbatim-quote findings, ranked findings, an escalating merge verdict and verified doc fixes.

pr-shepherd.description: Review pull-request hunks against team rules from a JSON file, stdin, or --hunks/--rules arguments.

arguments.name: file
arguments.description: Path to a JSON file containing { hunks, rules, options? }.

arguments.name: hunks
arguments.description: Pull-request hunks to review directly instead of reading a file.

arguments.name: rules
arguments.description: Team engineering rules to check against non-trivial hunks.
